Costanera Center

One of the most recognisable malls for tourists, with great variety, convenient metro connections and a practical mix of shopping, food and urban strolling.

Best for

  • First visit
  • Quick shopping
  • Tourists without a car

Not ideal for

  • Those seeking peace during rush hour

Getting there

Close to Tobalaba station.

Recommended time: 2–4 hours
